gloss: one's last moments; dying hour; end of life

definitions.gloss: one's last moments; death; dying hour
definitions.explanation: The moment of a person's death, and the circumstances surrounding it. Used only of living beings and, by extension, of organizations or eras being spoken of as if they died.

examples.japanese: {立派|りっぱ}な{最期|さいご}だった。
{父|ちち}の{最期|さいご}を{看取|みと}ることができた。
examples.english: I was able to be at my father's side at the end.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{最期|さいご}の{瞬間|しゅんかん}まで、{家族|かぞく}のことを{気|き}にかけていた。
examples.english: Right up to his final moment, he was concerned about his family.

notes:
Homophone of {最後|さいご} (the last one, the end) but not interchangeable: {最期|さいご} is only about the end of a life. Writing ✗{最後|さいご}を{看取|みと}る for a deathbed is a common kanji mistake.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {最期|さいご}を{看取|みと}る: to be with someone when they die
- {最期|さいご}を{遂|と}げる: to meet one's end (in a particular way)
- {最期|さいご}の{言葉|ことば}: last words
- {悲惨|ひさん}な{最期|さいご}: a tragic end

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {最後|さいご}: the last, the end — general-purpose; use for anything other than dying
- {臨終|りんじゅう}: one's dying hour — more formal and clinical, used in medical and religious contexts
